evidence: Alters ConnectBlock script check dispatching in src/validation.cpp and fixes script execution cache insertion in TestBlockValidity.
rationale: Unifies single-threaded and multithreaded script check execution paths in ConnectBlock through CCheckQueue while resolving a long-standing omission in TestBlockValidity cache population. The change simplifies critical validation code and removes dual-mode behavior in CheckInputScripts, but remains an internal refactor without blocking major features.
